scope: Static audit of special keyboard/name/gameplay triggers in the original software-rendered NFS2SEN executable and generated C++.

entries.guide_trigger: Hold N while the race loads
entries.menu_operation: Arm for the next race; temporarily hold the guest N byte only around the original setup routine, then restore the original key byte. Do not patch colors directly.
entries.note: No track guard appears in this trigger; no claim of visual verification.

entries.guide_trigger: C + B + Right Shift six times before the start and six times again
entries.conditions: The original camera setup samples held keys; this routine contains no six-press counter.

effects.shift_C_and_B: table[3]=4 and table[7]=8 (0x439589), giving camera cycle 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,0
effects.consumer: 0x4380af reads next camera at 0x4dc9f9 + current camera

entries.menu_operation: Arm nine cameras for the next race and temporarily set the three guest keyboard bytes around original sub_439320, restoring prior bytes after the call.

entries.guide_trigger: Set a track record and enter silspd as the name
entries.comparison: 0x459582–0x459597: compare car->driver(+0x21c)->name(+0x34) against exact case-sensitive literal SIL SPD at 0x4bb0fc using strcmp sub_4778f0
entries.effect: 0x4595a0 shifts car mass at +0xb4 left by 2 (four times normal), before computing inverse mass at +0xb8.
entries.menu_operation: Show the original record-name instruction. The typed frontend cheat handler does not recognize silspd; no global unlock flag was found.
entries.caveat: Comparison is byte-exact and requires uppercase SIL SPD including the space. Driver-name formatting/record entry conversion and persistence were not run-tested; the guide silspd cannot be assumed to match.

entries.guide_trigger: Simulation, McLaren F1, Mediterraneo/Mystic Peaks; reverse while sounding horn, hit a movable object, then hit a barrier fast
activation_conditions: 0x440b3b reads horn state car+0x2dd (either colliding car may be sounding horn)
0x440b51/0x440bcf require runtime track ID 6 or 7 in dword[0x4dd2fc]
0x440b5a/0x440b82 require player-car flag 0x04 at car+0x1f4 and the other object flag 0x40
consumer_conditions: Track 6 requires current segment car+0x14 inside (0x168,0x426) or (0x488,0x649)
entries.consumer_effect: Uses collision type 7 and the original jump path; this is not universal collision disabling.
entries.menu_operation: Help/instructions only; retain original collision and track conditions.
entries.caveat: No explicit McLaren model check appears in the identified activation/consumer blocks. The guide speed claims were not confirmed; executable uses the exact internal thresholds recorded here. No gameplay validation.

evidence: Keyboard getter sub_47a470 reads scan-code array 0x4c8584. Direct H/0x23 polling at 0x434090 and 0x4347f4 has no boost state use in the surrounding code.
Horn input is car+0x2dd (set from control bit4 at 0x44551b).

In slot physics sub_450370, 0x450575 checks horn while car+0x318 is set, then clears car+0x318 and starts car+0x31c=1. sub_450330 restores car+0x318 after this counter exceeds0x80. This is slot-related behavior, not proof of a universal H turbo.
entries.menu_operation: Mark the screenshot claim unverified and avoid a button that promises an unsupported boost.
entries.caveat: Absence of a direct key check is not proof no input-bound gameplay behavior exists; no claim of exhaustive dynamic test.

frontend_phase_guard.candidate: Both guest dword[0x4d58b8] and dword[0x4d58bc] are nonzero AND host execution is outside scoped movie playback main_loop0x422dd0.
evidence: sub_422990 (nfs2se.3.cpp:11124) allocates menu canvas pointers at0x4229ec and0x422a09.
Only caller of sub_422990 is frontend menu init sub_410ed0, call0x410efb.
sub_422730 (nfs2se.3.cpp:10346) clears both pointers at0x422753 and0x422784.
Frontend wrapper sub_408340 calls cleanup0x422730 at0x408491 before returning into race builder sub_44f0d0.
All static references to these pointers are confined to frontend menu draw/build/cleanup code0x4225xx–0x422a09.
do_not_use: 0x4dde89 is communication mode;0x4dde8a is race type, not frontend/race phase.
Generated main_loop0x422dd0 is movie playback and calls shared sub_405900 typed-cheat input.
0x4c82b4 is a timer callback and persists, unsuitable as a phase flag.
frontend_phase_guard.validation: Read-only runtime phase verification still required by root before adopting this guard.
limitations: Frontend menu canvas pointers can remain allocated while Showroom car videos play: sub_40d5c0 initializes the menu via sub_410ed0 at0x40d69d, then calls movie playback at0x40d993 without cleanup0x422730. Therefore pointers alone do not exclude every video.
A host scoped movie-depth counter around generated main_loop0x422dd0 can cleanly exclude movie playback.

automated_verification.typed_codes: Use original Application + public WinApplication runThread/dynamic_call on0x404df4 with guest CPU stack and EAX=character; assert exact bytes/dwords before/after, selected-car indices, toggling and guard rejection. This verifies executable state effects, not visible driving/render results.
automated_verification.night: Original sub_470d10 has only memory/math effects, including sub_469490 and sub_433530 which are simple global writes. Test N=1 exact output globals. For N=0 initialize valid horizon ranges (or run N=1 first); all-zero ranges may divide by zero in interpolation.

Allocate a zeroed fake car of at least0x684 bytes, store its guest pointer at0x4dcde8; use0x4dd2e8=0,0x4dd2ec=0,0x4dd2d8=0,0x4dd308=0. Test held-key permutations and next-camera table0x4dc9f9. The call to sub_4368d0 only stores two globals.
automated_verification.heavier_and_barrier: Use the exact static predicates above as documentation; full routine execution needs more race structures and may be outside this task. Do not report these as gameplay-tested.
